title: Urbanisation — core set
titleVi: Đô thị hoá — bộ từ cốt lõi
description: Bộ từ mô tả thành phố lớn lên nhanh thế nào, cái giá phải trả và những gì quy hoạch có thể sửa. Rất hữu ích vì đề Task 2 về đô thị hoá xuất hiện gần như mỗi năm.
ieltsUse: Dùng cho Task 2 các đề về tăng dân số đô thị, giao thông, nhà ở, quy hoạch; cũng dùng cho Task 1 khi mô tả biểu đồ dân số thành thị.

words.vi: sự mở rộng đô thị tự phát ra vùng ven
words.def: the uncontrolled spread of a city into surrounding countryside
words.example: Urban sprawl has swallowed thousands of hectares of farmland around the capital.

words.vi: vùng đô thị liên hoàn (nhiều thành phố hợp lại)
words.def: a large urban area formed by several towns merging
words.example: The conurbation stretching from the coast inland is home to twelve million people.

words.def: facilities that make a place pleasant to live in
words.example: New housing estates often lack basic amenities such as schools and clinics.

words.def: the state of being too crowded, especially with traffic
words.example: Traffic congestion costs the economy billions in lost working hours every year.

words.def: the condition of having too many people in one place
words.example: Overcrowding in inner-city flats has been linked to poor mental health.

words.vi: di cư từ nông thôn ra thành thị
words.def: the movement of people from the countryside to cities
words.example: Rural-to-urban migration has emptied hundreds of villages in the northern provinces.

words.vi: sự quý hoá đô thị (giàu hoá khu nghèo, đẩy cư dân cũ đi)
words.def: the renovation of a poor area that pushes out local residents
words.example: Gentrification has transformed the old docks into expensive apartments.

words.def: an overcrowded area with poor housing and sanitation
words.example: Millions of migrants end up in slums because formal housing is unaffordable.

words.vi: khu nhà tạm, không có dịch vụ cơ bản
words.def: a settlement of improvised dwellings without basic services
words.example: A shanty town grew up beside the railway within a single year.

words.vi: quy hoạch phân khu chức năng
words.def: official rules dividing land for particular uses
words.example: Relaxed zoning has allowed factories to be built next to residential blocks.

words.vi: vành đai xanh (đất nông nghiệp được bảo vệ quanh đô thị)
words.def: protected countryside around a city where building is restricted
words.example: The green belt has prevented the city from expanding into valuable farmland.

words.def: to travel regularly between home and work
words.example: Many employees commute two hours each way because rents near the centre are unaffordable.

words.vi: biến thành phố/khu phố đi bộ
words.def: to close a street to motor vehicles
words.example: The council pedestrianised the old quarter and air quality improved within months.

words.vi: khu phát triển đa chức năng (ở, làm việc, mua sắm)
words.def: a building or area combining housing, shops and offices
words.example: Mixed-use development shortens journeys because people live close to their workplaces.

words.def: homes priced so that ordinary residents can rent or buy them
words.example: Without affordable housing, key workers cannot afford to live in the city.

words.def: the number of people living in a given area
words.example: Population density in the old town is five times the national average.

words.def: the system of pipes that carries away rainwater and waste
words.example: Rapid growth has outpaced investment in drainage, so streets flood every monsoon.

words.def: the collection and disposal of rubbish
words.example: Efficient waste management is essential in cities that generate tonnes of rubbish daily.

words.vi: sự tái phát triển đô thị
words.def: the process of improving a declining urban area
words.example: Urban regeneration brought new jobs but also much higher rents.

words.vi: thuộc đô thị lớn và vùng phụ cận
words.def: relating to a large city and its surrounding area
words.example: The metropolitan area now stretches forty kilometres from the centre.

words.def: an area of a city where people live outside the centre
words.example: Families increasingly move to the suburbs in search of larger homes.

words.def: relating to the countryside rather than towns
words.example: Young people leave rural areas because jobs and universities are concentrated in cities.

words.vi: sự phụ thuộc vào ô tô
words.def: a situation in which people must drive for everyday journeys
words.example: Car dependency makes life difficult for residents who cannot afford a vehicle.

words.def: the degree to which a place is good to live in
words.example: Planners are now judged on liveability rather than on the number of new roads.

words.def: a very tall building containing many flats
words.example: A cluster of high-rise blocks now dominates the skyline of the eastern district.
